framing_en: Screening result under the named standard only, computed from the company's published financials. This is not a fatwa, and not religious or investment advice.

rows.framing_en: Screening result under the named standard only, computed from the company's published financials. This is not a fatwa, and not religious or investment advice.

purification.notes_ar: نفس قاعدة سلسلة المؤشرات: عامل تعديل التوزيعات = (إجمالي الدخل − (إيرادات الأنشطة المحظورة + دخل الفوائد)) / إجمالي الدخل (القسم 2.3)، وحصة التوزيع الواجبة التطهير هي 1 − العامل. لا تنشر MSCI قيمة تطهير للسهم الواحد.
purification.notes_en: The Index Series rule: the dividend adjustment factor is (Total Income - (revenue from prohibited activities + interest income)) / Total Income (methodology section 2.3), and the share of a dividend to purify is 1 - DAF — this rule set's purification ratio. MSCI publishes no per-share purification figure, so per_share_definition is null and no per-share figure is produced.
